# GOG — York mission unlocked after reloading the prior ending

- Original source: [Endless ambush missions?](https://www.gog.com/forum/robin_hood_legend_of_sherwood/endless_ambush_missions/page1)
- Author / publication: hdupuis; GOG forum.
- Language / date: English; 2019-06-04.
- Access: Full thread (both posts) retrieved directly
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: lookup failed (archive.org rate limit); not checked
- Format: header notes, original summary, then complete post-by-post notes (forum thread, not transcribed)

After sending Allan away with the king’s ransom, hdupuis reports that only ambushes remain available. They observe the expected 100,000 deduction, yet subsequent messages still refer to raising ransom money.

In a same-day follow-up, the author reloads a save from immediately before ending the Allan mission and completes the transition again. This time the scout-return message appears and the York mission unlocks. It is a player-confirmed workaround for that run, with the underlying cause unresolved. The report concerns a post-ransom transition and should not automatically be grouped with missing Robin-rescue missions.

## Detailed notes

Page facts: GOG forum thread "Endless ambush missions?" in the Robin Hood Legend of Sherwood subforum; 2 posts, both by hdupuis (New User; registered Jul 2014; United States), both dated 2019-06-04; no post marked as the solution. Retrieved directly from gog.com on 2026-09-09 (the page chrome rendered partly in French, the posts are in English). Forum threads are not licensed for reproduction, so the posts are summarised.

Post 1 (hdupuis, 2019-06-04):

- Had just finished the mission where Robin meets Allan and sends him off with the ransom for the king.
- Back in Sherwood Forest only ambush missions were offered instead of story progress.
- Suspects the game did not register that the 100,000 pounds had been collected and sent. Money dropped from about 113,000 to 13,000 as soon as the previous mission ended, yet the messages after completing an ambush still say things like "this will help Robin collect the money for the ransom".
- Has a save from just before pressing the "end mission" button after sending Allan off and considers reloading it and ending again, because the ambushes get boring quickly (though they allow practising speedruns of the maps).

Post 2 (hdupuis, 2019-06-04, follow-up):

- Reloaded at the end of the "meet Allan" mission and ended it again.
- This time, on returning to Sherwood, the "spies are back from scouting" message appeared immediately and the mission to take York was available.
- Cause of the original problem unknown; "forcing the game to recalculate" appears to have fixed it.
- Has played through the game multiple times without ever hitting this before; hopes to finish the last two missions without issues.

Facts usable for parity work: the ransom mission ends with a deduction of roughly 100,000 from the treasury; the expected post-mission transition is a scout-return message that unlocks the York mission; the failure mode leaves the ambush generator running with ransom-collection flavour text; re-running the mission end from a pre-end save produced the correct transition.
